title: ADA Method-Parameter Template Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification method-parameter templates derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Each $def constrains one method-level (readOnly:true) parameter template (e.g. DriftCorrection, massAbsorptionCoefficients). TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs (schema.yaml#/$defs/<name>) so they resolve locally through the building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties of its own.

tem_samplePersistentIdentifierDefault.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
tem_samplePersistentIdentifierDefault.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

tem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDefaul.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
tem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDefaul.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

tem_temObjectiveApertureDefault.title: TEM Objective Aperture
tem_temObjectiveApertureDefault.description: Objective aperture diameter used to select the imaging beam condition in TEM mode. In BF-TEM, a small aperture blocks diffracted beams to enhance mass-thickness contrast; in DF-TEM, the aperture is displaced to select a specific diffracted beam; in HRTEM, no aperture is typically used.

tem_eftemEnergyWindowDefault.title: EFTEM Energy Window
tem_eftemEnergyWindowDefault.description: Energy window(s) used for EFTEM elemental mapping: center energy, width, and acquisition method (three-window or jump-ratio). Record 'N/A' where EFTEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_haadfCollectionAnglesDefault.title: HAADF Collection Angles
tem_haadfCollectionAnglesDefault.description: Inner and outer collection angles of the HAADF detector in milliradians (mrad). The inner angle determines the boundary between diffracted and thermally diffuse scattered electrons; larger inner angles yield stronger Z-contrast and reduced Bragg contrast. Inner angle is most critical and can be derived from camera length and detector geometry. In HAADF-STEM a shorter camera length increases the inner angle, yielding more thermally diffuse (Z-contrast) and less Bragg-diffraction signal.

tem_stemProbeDiameterDefault.title: STEM Probe Diameter
tem_stemProbeDiameterDefault.description: Nominal or measured diameter of the focused electron probe at the sample, reported in nm. Serves as a direct spatial resolution proxy for STEM imaging and STEM-EDS/EELS analysis. Related to, but distinct from, Convergence Semi-Angle: the two quantities are connected via aberration coefficients, defocus, and probe current, which are not always published. Report whichever is known; if both are known, report both fields. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemProbeCurrentDefault.title: STEM Probe Current
tem_stemProbeCurrentDefault.description: Probe current in picoamperes (pA) or nanoamperes (nA). Higher current improves EDS/EELS signal but increases beam damage risk, especially for organic matter and hydrous minerals. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemScanDimensionsDefault.title: STEM Scan Dimensions
tem_stemScanDimensionsDefault.description: Number of pixels in the STEM scan frame (X × Y pixels). Combined with calibrated pixel size, defines the field of view. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_stemFrameAveragingDefault.title: STEM Frame Averaging
tem_stemFrameAveragingDefault.description: Number of frames averaged (with drift correction if applicable) to produce the final STEM image. Averaging reduces noise while limiting per-frame dose. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

tem_selectedAreaApertureSizeDefault.title: Selected-Area Aperture Size
tem_selectedAreaApertureSizeDefault.description: Diameter of the selected-area aperture used in SAED mode, defining the specimen region that contributes to the diffraction pattern.

tem_precessionAngleDefault.title: Precession Angle
tem_precessionAngleDefault.description: Precession semi-angle in degrees for precession electron diffraction (PED). Hollow-cone illumination reduces dynamical diffraction effects and produces more kinematical-like intensities. Not applicable to SAED, CBED, or standard 4D-STEM. Record 'N/A' where Precession ED is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_stemScanGridAndArea4DDefault.title: 4D-STEM Scan Grid and Area
tem_stemScanGridAndArea4DDefault.description: Number of probe positions in the 4D-STEM dataset (scan pixels × scan pixels) and the physical area covered. Probe step size is the physical area divided by scan pixel count. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_stemDwellTimePerProbePosition4DDefau.title: 4D-STEM Dwell Time per Probe Position
tem_stemDwellTimePerProbePosition4DDefau.description: Time spent acquiring each diffraction pattern in the 4D-STEM dataset in milliseconds. Longer dwell improves signal-to-noise for weakly diffracting phases (e.g., smectite 001 reflection at ~1.24 nm) but increases total specimen dose; risk of beam damage to phyllosilicates and organic matter must be balanced against data quality. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

tem_diffractionCameraLengthCalibrationMe.title: Diffraction Camera Length Calibration Method
tem_diffractionCameraLengthCalibrationMe.description: Method used to calibrate the camera length constant and convert pixel distances in diffraction patterns to d-spacings or reciprocal lattice vectors.

tem_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixelDefault.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
tem_edsLiveTimePerPointOrPixelDefault.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point (point/line mode) or per pixel (spectrum image) in seconds. Also referred to as "EDS Acquisition Time" in EPMA and some SEM-EDS contexts, where the per-pixel distinction is less relevant. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

tem_edsEnergyRangeDefault.title: EDS Energy Range
tem_edsEnergyRangeDefault.description: Energy range of EDS spectrum acquisition in keV. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsBackgroundSubtractionMethodDefau.title: EELS Background Subtraction Method
tem_eelsBackgroundSubtractionMethodDefau.description: Method used to subtract the background beneath the ionization edge of interest to extract the net edge signal. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsPluralScatteringCorrectionDefaul.title: EELS Plural Scattering Correction
tem_eelsPluralScatteringCorrectionDefaul.description: Method applied to correct for multiple inelastic scattering events (plural scattering) that broaden edge fine structure. Critical for specimens thicker than ~0.5 inelastic mean free paths. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_imageProcessingMethodsAppliedDefault.title: Image Processing Methods Applied
tem_imageProcessingMethodsAppliedDefault.description: Image processing steps applied to TEM or STEM images during or after acquisition. Non-linear processing steps that could affect quantitative interpretation should be documented explicitly.

tem_specimenThicknessDeterminationMethod.title: Specimen Thickness Determination Method
tem_specimenThicknessDeterminationMethod.description: Method used to estimate TEM foil thickness. Required for EELS quantification (log-ratio) and for assessing multiple-scattering severity.

tem_eelsEnergyCalibrationDefault.title: EELS Energy Calibration
tem_eelsEnergyCalibrationDefault.description: Method and reference used to calibrate the EELS energy axis. Accurate calibration is required for ELNES edge identification, chemical-state analysis, and inter-lab comparability. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_diffractionCalibrationReferenceDefau.title: Diffraction Calibration Reference
tem_diffractionCalibrationReferenceDefau.description: Reference material or internal standard used to calibrate the electron diffraction camera constant (camera length × electron wavelength), enabling conversion of pixel distances to d-spacings.

tem_edsDetectionLimitDefault.title: EDS Detection Limit
tem_edsDetectionLimitDefault.description: Estimated detection limits by EDS under this procedure's conditions, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set). Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_edsCountingStatisticsAccumulationCri.title: EDS Counting Statistics / Accumulation Criterion
tem_edsCountingStatisticsAccumulationCri.description: Quality criterion used to determine when sufficient EDS signal has been accumulated for a given pixel or point, in lieu of or in addition to a fixed live time. Expressed as a target relative uncertainty on major-element peak counts achieved by accumulating successive scan frames (e.g., "1% counting statistics on major elements"; ">10% counting statistics"). Distinct from EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel, which records a fixed-duration setting. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

tem_eelsSensitivityAndDetectionLimitDefa.title: EELS Sensitivity and Detection Limit
tem_eelsSensitivityAndDetectionLimitDefa.description: Practical energy resolution (ZLP FWHM measured at operating conditions) and estimated detection limit or minimum detectable concentration for target edges under this procedure. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

solutionMcicpms_samplePersistentIdentifi.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
solutionMcicpms_samplePersistentIdentifi.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

solutionMcicpms_sampleAliquotMassOrVolum.title: Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume
solutionMcicpms_sampleAliquotMassOrVolum.description: Mass (mg) of solid material digested or volume (mL) of liquid taken for dissolution. Used for yield calculations and concentration back-calculation.

solutionMcicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOr.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
solutionMcicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOr.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit. Supports traceability to instrument service records.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

solutionMcicpms_torchDepthDefault.title: Torch Depth
solutionMcicpms_torchDepthDefault.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer. Affects ion transmission efficiency, oxide formation, and doubly-charged species production. The procedure specifies a target value optimised during initial setup; the analyst confirms or fine-adjusts during session tuning.

solutionMcicpms_makeUpGasFlowRateDefault.title: Make-up Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_makeUpGasFlowRateDefault.description: Supplementary argon flow added downstream of a desolvation system to maintain total gas delivery to the plasma (L/min). Record 'N/A' if no desolvation system is used. Record 'N/A' where Desolvation System is 'None'.

solutionMcicpms_reactionGasFlowRateDefau.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
solutionMcicpms_reactionGasFlowRateDefau.description: Flow rate of the reaction gas in DRC mode (mL/min), on collision/reaction-cell-equipped MC-ICP-MS instruments. Record 'N/A' if the instrument has no cell or DRC mode is not used. Record 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include DRC.

solutionMcicpms_doubleSpikeMixingRatioDe.title: Double-Spike Mixing Ratio
solutionMcicpms_doubleSpikeMixingRatioDe.description: Target proportion of double-spike signal relative to total analyte signal in the spiked mixture, expressed as spike fraction (0–1) or spike:sample ratio. An optimal mixing ratio minimizes error propagation through the double-spike inversion; the optimum is analyte-system specific and is typically determined using the Double Spike Toolbox or equivalent. The achieved mixing ratio may deviate from the target within acceptable bounds (typically ±20% of optimal); the double-spike inversion corrects for actual mixing ratios. Record 'N/A' if double-spike method is not used. Record 'N/A' where the procedure does not use a double spike.

solutionMcicpms_spikeOutlierFilteringApp.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
solutionMcicpms_spikeOutlierFilteringApp.description: Criteria used to identify and exclude anomalous cycles or replicate measurements from the calculated isotope ratio mean. Filtering is applied after baseline subtraction and before mass bias correction.

solutionMcicpms_memoryEffectMitigationDe.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
solutionMcicpms_memoryEffectMitigationDe.description: Procedure applied to minimize carryover of analyte isotopes between successive sample introductions. In MC-ICP-MS, extended rinse periods with the same acid matrix as samples (see Wash Time Between Samples) are the primary mitigation. At data processing level, documents any flagging or exclusion of measurements preceded by samples with significantly different isotopic compositions where carryover may be suspected.

solutionMcicpms_uncertaintyPropagationMe.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
solutionMcicpms_uncertaintyPropagationMe.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

solutionMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBa.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
solutionMcicpms_normalizationStandardsBa.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to output isotope ratio data beyond the primary mass bias correction. Examples: correction of δ values for decay of enriched spike isotopes between calibration and use date (double-spike procedures); age correction of δ238U for secular disequilibrium. Record 'None' if no additional normalization is applied.

solutionMcicpms_errorCorrelationBetweenR.title: Error Correlation Between Reported Quantities
solutionMcicpms_errorCorrelationBetweenR.description: The correlation coefficient between pairs of reported quantities whose uncertainties are not independent, together with the pair it applies to and how it was obtained. Concordia and isochron regressions cannot be reconstructed without it.

solutionMcicpms_inRunIsotopeRatioReprodu.title: In-Run Isotope Ratio Reproducibility and Assessment Method
solutionMcicpms_inRunIsotopeRatioReprodu.description: Reproducibility of isotope ratio or δ-value measurements within a single analytical session and the method used to assess it. For solution MC-ICP-MS, precision is reported as 2σ (two standard deviations) or 2SE (two standard errors of the mean) on replicate analyses of an isotopic standard or secondary reference material run as an unknown during the session. Specify: (1) the metric (2σ, 2SD, 2SE, 95% CI); (2) the reference material or standard analyzed; (3) the number of replicate measurements; (4) the ratio pair or δ value assessed. Example: 2SD = 0.03‰ on δ56Fe (n = 10 BHVO-2 analyses in session).

schema:name.const: In-Run Isotope Ratio Reproducibility and Assessment Method

solutionMcicpms_betweenSessionReproducib.title: Between-Session Reproducibility and Assessment Method
solutionMcicpms_betweenSessionReproducib.description: Reproducibility of isotope ratio or δ-value measurements across multiple analytical sessions (long-term external reproducibility) and the method used to assess it. Typically expressed as 2SD of repeated independent measurements of a secondary reference material across sessions over weeks to months. Specify: (1) the metric; (2) the reference material; (3) the number of measurements and sessions; (4) the ratio or δ value assessed.

solutionMcicpms_detectionLimitDefault.title: Detection Limit
solutionMcicpms_detectionLimitDefault.description: Elemental detection limits, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set), applicable when isotope dilution concentrations are also reported. For pure isotope ratio procedures (no concentration output), this field is N/A or reports the minimum sample mass required for a measurement at target precision. Specify units µg/g or µg/L and whether values are procedure-typical estimates or session-measured. Record 'N/A' where the procedure produces isotope ratios only and reports no concentrations.

solutionMcicpms_limitOfQuantificationMet.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
solutionMcicpms_limitOfQuantificationMet.description: Method used to determine the limit of quantification, where applicable.

semImaging_samplePersistentIdentifierDef.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
semImaging_samplePersistentIdentifierDef.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

semImaging_preAnalysisImagingAndScreenin.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
semImaging_preAnalysisImagingAndScreenin.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

semImaging_chamberPressureDefault.title: Chamber Pressure
semImaging_chamberPressureDefault.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

semImaging_imagePixelSizeDefault.title: Image Pixel Size
semImaging_imagePixelSizeDefault.description: Physical size of each image pixel at the sample surface, in nm or µm. Defines spatial sampling of SE or BSE images. For large-area mosaic imaging, report the pixel size of individual tiles and the number and arrangement of tiles.

semImaging_ebsdFrameTimeDefault.title: EBSD Frame Time
semImaging_ebsdFrameTimeDefault.description: Acquisition time per EBSD diffraction pattern frame in milliseconds. Longer frame time improves pattern quality and indexing rate but increases total acquisition time.

semImaging_ebsdPatternQualityThresholdDe.title: EBSD Pattern Quality Threshold
semImaging_ebsdPatternQualityThresholdDe.description: Minimum pattern quality or confidence index threshold applied during EBSD data processing to exclude unreliably indexed points from orientation maps. Include metric name and threshold value.

semImaging_clWavelengthCalibrationRefere.title: CL Wavelength Calibration Reference
semImaging_clWavelengthCalibrationRefere.description: Reference light source or standard material used to calibrate the wavelength axis of the CL spectrometer. Required for quantitative spectral CL and hyperspectral mapping.

solutionQicpms_samplePersistentIdentifie.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
solutionQicpms_samplePersistentIdentifie.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

solutionQicpms_sampleAliquotMassOrVolume.title: Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume
solutionQicpms_sampleAliquotMassOrVolume.description: Mass (mg) of solid material digested or volume (mL) of liquid taken for dissolution. Used for yield calculations and concentration back-calculation.

solutionQicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOrL.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
solutionQicpms_instrumentSerialNumberOrL.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit. Supports traceability to instrument service records.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

solutionQicpms_torchDepthDefault.title: Torch Depth
solutionQicpms_torchDepthDefault.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer. Affects ion transmission efficiency, oxide formation, and doubly-charged species production. The procedure specifies a target value optimised during initial setup; the analyst confirms or fine-adjusts during session tuning.

solutionQicpms_makeUpGasFlowRateDefault.title: Make-up Gas Flow Rate
solutionQicpms_makeUpGasFlowRateDefault.description: Supplementary argon flow added downstream of a desolvation system to maintain total gas delivery to the plasma (L/min). Record 'N/A' if no desolvation system is used. Record 'N/A' where Desolvation System is 'None'.

solutionQicpms_reactionGasFlowRateDefaul.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
solutionQicpms_reactionGasFlowRateDefaul.description: Flow rate of the reaction gas in DRC mode (mL/min). Record 'N/A' if DRC mode is not used. Record 'N/A' where Collision/Reaction Cell (CRC) Configuration does not include DRC.

solutionQicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonit.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
solutionQicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonit.description: Mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M2+) formation during instrument tuning. Doubly-charged ions appear at half the nominal mass of the parent ion and can interfere with lighter analyte masses. Ba2+/Ba+ (m/z 69/138) and Ce2+/Ce+ (m/z 70/140) are the most common proxies for solution ICP-MS.

solutionQicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProdu.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
solutionQicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProdu.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. Record both the acceptance threshold and the measured value. Elevated doubly-charged production indicates incomplete ionization and potential interference on elements at approximately half the mass of abundant matrix components.

solutionQicpms_spikeOutlierFilteringAppr.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
solutionQicpms_spikeOutlierFilteringAppr.description: Criteria used to identify and exclude anomalous replicate measurements or data points from the calculated mean.

solutionQicpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlin.title: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
solutionQicpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonlin.description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response at the transition between pulse-counting and analog detection modes. For Q-ICP-MS instruments with dual-mode SEM detectors, a cross-calibration factor is measured and applied at the pulse-to-analog crossover threshold. Accurate cross-calibration is critical for analytes spanning a wide concentration range in the same session.

solutionQicpms_memoryEffectMitigationDef.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
solutionQicpms_memoryEffectMitigationDef.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimize carry-over of high-concentration elements between successive sample introductions. For solution ICP-MS, mitigation is implemented primarily at measurement time through extended rinse periods (see Wash Time Between Samples, Group 4). At data processing level, documents any flagging or exclusion of measurements preceded by high-concentration samples or standards where the required washout time may not have been achieved.

solutionQicpms_uncertaintyPropagationMet.title: Uncertainty Propagation Method
solutionQicpms_uncertaintyPropagationMet.description: The approach used to propagate analytical uncertainty through the data reduction chain to the final reported value. State which sources are included in the propagation: counting statistics, calibration standard uncertainty, internal standard uncertainty, drift correction, and any systematic contributions. Distinct from Uncertainty Level, which states the convention at which the resulting uncertainty is quoted.

solutionQicpms_normalizationStandardsBas.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
solutionQicpms_normalizationStandardsBas.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied to output concentrations relative to a reference value (e.g., correction to a monitor element's certified value in the calibration standard).

solutionQicpms_detectionLimitDefault.title: Detection Limit
solutionQicpms_detectionLimitDefault.description: Elemental detection limits, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set). Specify units (µg/g or µg/L) and whether values are procedure-typical estimates or session-specific measured values.

solutionQicpms_limitOfQuantificationMeth.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
solutionQicpms_limitOfQuantificationMeth.description: Method used to determine the limit of quantification.

solutionQicpms_betweenSessionAnalyticalP.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
solutionQicpms_betweenSessionAnalyticalP.description: Reproducibility of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months (long-term or intermediate precision). Report both the assessment method and the precision values. Specify: reference material used, number of sessions n, time span covered, and statistic reported. Long-term precision is typically assessed from a compiled record of secondary reference material values across all sessions.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

solutionSficpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonli.title: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
solutionSficpms_pulseAnalogDetectorNonli.description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear detector response at the transition between pulse-counting and analog (and Faraday, for triple-mode instruments) detection modes. For SF-ICP-MS instruments, the signal transitions between pulse counting (low concentrations) and analog detection (high concentrations). For triple-mode instruments (e.g., Thermo Element XR), an additional transition to Faraday cup detection occurs at the highest signal intensities. Cross-calibration factors between detector modes must be confirmed, typically measured each session.

empa_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDefau.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
empa_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDefau.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

empa_beamRasterDimensionsDefault.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
empa_beamRasterDimensionsDefault.description: X x Y dimensions of a small beam raster used at a single analysis point to average a coarse-grained or beam-sensitive phase. Different from X-ray mapping mode; not applicable when mapping.

empa_beamDamageMinimizationDefault.title: Beam Damage Minimization
empa_beamDamageMinimizationDefault.description: Measures taken to minimize beam damage, particularly volatilization or migration of Na, K, F, and Cl in hydrous minerals, glasses, feldspars, phosphates, and carbonates. Document approach, beam conditions used, and phases for which it was applied.

empa_driftCorrectionDefault.title: Drift Correction
empa_driftCorrectionDefault.description: Method used to monitor and correct for instrument drift (beam current drift, spectrometer drift) during the analytical session.

empa_backgroundPositionDefault.title: Background Position(s)
empa_backgroundPositionDefault.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

empa_timeDependentIntensityCorrectionDef.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
empa_timeDependentIntensityCorrectionDef.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilization or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates). Most commonly applied in point analysis; uncommon for X-ray mapping.

empa_halogenCorrectionOnOxygenDefault.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
empa_halogenCorrectionOnOxygenDefault.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.

empa_blankCorrectionDefault.title: Blank Correction
empa_blankCorrectionDefault.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
empa_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrecti.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials to correct for session-to-session calibration drift.

empa_detectionLimitDefault.title: Detection Limit
empa_detectionLimitDefault.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence (3-sigma), one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set), derived from counting statistics on peak and background. Include the method and the resulting value for each.

empa_analyticalPrecisionDefault.title: Analytical Precision
empa_analyticalPrecisionDefault.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent reference material, expressed as 1-sigma relative standard deviation (%). Include reference material name, number of analyses (n), and value per analyte or element group.

empa_analyticalAccuracyDefault.title: Analytical Accuracy
empa_analyticalAccuracyDefault.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as percent relative bias. Include reference material, reference value source, and per-analyte value.

empa_countingStatisticsErrorDefault.title: Counting Statistics Error
empa_countingStatisticsErrorDefault.description: 1-sigma uncertainty propagated from counting statistics on peak and background intensities, for each reported concentration variable per analysis.

geochron_imagingDefault.title: Imaging
geochron_imagingDefault.description: Pre-ablation characterisation imaging (typically cathodoluminescence [CL] or backscattered electron [BSE]) used to reveal internal zoning, inherited cores, and metamict domains for selecting valid spot locations, including the imaging instrument and settings used.

geochron_preAblationSurfaceTreatmentDefa.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
geochron_preAblationSurfaceTreatmentDefa.description: Procedure applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface, distinct from general sample preparation. Pre-ablation pulses are typically discarded before signal acquisition begins.

geochron_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabIden.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
geochron_instrumentSerialNumberOrLabIden.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit. Supports traceability to instrument service records.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

geochron_torchDepthDefault.title: Torch Depth
geochron_torchDepthDefault.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position. Affects ion transmission efficiency, oxide formation, and doubly-charged species production.

geochron_massResolutionSettingDefault.title: Mass Resolution Setting
geochron_massResolutionSettingDefault.description: Operating mass resolution of the mass analyser. Fixed at unit resolution for quadrupole instruments; selectable (low/medium/high) for sector-field instruments to balance sensitivity against interference suppression; not applicable in the same sense for multi-collector instruments running static low-resolution collection (see Faraday Cup Array Configuration and Collector Configuration for MC-specific detail).

geochron_ablationPitDepthAblationRateDef.title: Ablation Pit Depth/Ablation Rate
geochron_ablationPitDepthAblationRateDef.description: Depth of the ablation pit produced under the registered laser conditions, the method used to measure it, and the resulting per-pulse ablation rate. Characterises the achievable depth/time resolution of the procedure.

geochron_makeUpGasFlowDefault.title: Make-up Gas Flow (L min⁻¹)
geochron_makeUpGasFlowDefault.description: Source and estimated flow rate of any make-up gas added downstream of the ablation cell, including any desolvating nebuliser used for tracer co-aspiration.

geochron_coolantGasFlowRateDefault.title: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
geochron_coolantGasFlowRateDefault.description: Flow rate of the outer (coolant/plasma) argon gas stream that sustains the ICP plasma. Determines plasma volume and stability.

geochron_auxiliaryGasFlowRateDefault.title: Auxiliary Gas Flow Rate
geochron_auxiliaryGasFlowRateDefault.description: Flow rate of the intermediate (auxiliary) argon gas stream that positions the plasma relative to the load coil. Affects ion extraction efficiency and oxide production rates.

geochron_numberOfBlocksPerMeasurementDef.title: Number of Blocks per Measurement
geochron_numberOfBlocksPerMeasurementDef.description: Number of measurement blocks acquired per spot. Each block typically begins with a baseline (on-peak zero) measurement before the analytical cycles. Multiple blocks allow inspection of signal stability and within-measurement drift.

geochron_numberOfCyclesPerBlockDefault.title: Number of Cycles per Block
geochron_numberOfCyclesPerBlockDefault.description: Number of measurement cycles acquired per block. One cycle corresponds to a single set of simultaneous Faraday cup readings integrated for the duration in Integration Time per Cycle.

geochron_integrationTimePerCycleDefault.title: Integration Time per Cycle
geochron_integrationTimePerCycleDefault.description: Duration of signal integration per measurement cycle. Total integration time per spot = (Number of Cycles per Block) × (Integration Time per Cycle) × (Number of Blocks per Measurement).

geochron_icDeadTimeDefault.title: IC Dead Time (ns)
geochron_icDeadTimeDefault.description: Dead time of each ion-counting detector channel, used in dead-time correction of high count rates.

geochron_signalSmoothingDefault.title: Signal Smoothing
geochron_signalSmoothingDefault.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability.

geochron_icpTuningDefault.title: ICP Tuning
geochron_icpTuningDefault.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria.

geochron_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitorDefa.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
geochron_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitorDefa.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning.

geochron_doublyChargedSpeciesProductionD.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
geochron_doublyChargedSpeciesProductionD.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning.

geochron_analysisSequenceDefault.title: Analysis Sequence
geochron_analysisSequenceDefault.description: Repeating order of primary calibration standard(s), quality control standard(s), and unknown analyses within a measurement session.

geochron_collisionGasFlowRateDefault.title: Collision Gas Flow Rate
geochron_collisionGasFlowRateDefault.description: Flow rate of the collision gas in KED mode. Higher flow rates provide greater interference suppression at the cost of analyte sensitivity. Applies to quadrupole-based instruments and to collision-cell-equipped multi-collector instruments (e.g., Nu Sapphire, Thermo Neoma MS/MS) operating in KED mode.

geochron_cellExitDiscriminationVoltageDe.title: Cell Exit Discrimination Voltage
geochron_cellExitDiscriminationVoltageDe.description: Kinetic energy discrimination offset voltage applied at the exit of the collision cell in KED mode. Applies to quadrupole-based instruments and to collision-cell-equipped multi-collector instruments (e.g., Nu Sapphire, Thermo Neoma MS/MS) operating in KED mode.

geochron_reactionGasFlowRateDefault.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
geochron_reactionGasFlowRateDefault.description: Flow rate of the reactive gas introduced into the dynamic reaction cell (DRC). Applies to quadrupole-based instruments and to collision-cell-equipped multi-collector instruments (e.g., Nu Sapphire, Thermo Neoma MS/MS) operating in DRC mode.

geochron_otherInformationDefault.title: Other Information
geochron_otherInformationDefault.description: Supplementary methodological context not captured by the structured fields above, as reported in Table 3 of Horstwood et al. (2016) — in the source paper's own example, notes on ablation-cell and sample-line configuration for depth-profiling/single-pulse ablation studies, a variant not otherwise in scope for this single-mode (Spot Analysis) TAPP.

geochron_uncertaintyLevelAndPropagationD.title: Uncertainty Level and Propagation
geochron_uncertaintyLevelAndPropagationD.description: Uncertainty level at which ages/ratios are quoted (e.g., 1σ, 2σ) and the method used to propagate component uncertainties (e.g., quadratic addition) into the final reported value.

geochron_spikeOutlierFilteringApproachDe.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
geochron_spikeOutlierFilteringApproachDe.description: Method used to identify and remove anomalous signal spikes arising from micronuggets, inclusions, cracks, or instrument artifacts during time-resolved signal processing.

geochron_doubleSpikeMixingRatioDefault.title: Double-Spike Mixing Ratio
geochron_doubleSpikeMixingRatioDefault.description: Target proportion of double-spike signal relative to total analyte signal in the spiked mixture. An optimal mixing ratio minimises error propagation through the double-spike inversion. Record 'N/A' if double-spike method is not used.

geochron_memoryEffectMitigationDefault.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
geochron_memoryEffectMitigationDefault.description: Procedure applied to identify and minimise memory effects from high-concentration elements in the previous sample or standard that may contaminate subsequent analyses.

geochron_normalizationStandardsBasedCorr.title: Normalization/Standards-Based Correction
geochron_normalizationStandardsBasedCorr.description: Any post-acquisition normalization applied to correct for systematic biases identified from secondary reference materials.

geochron_betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecisi.title: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method
geochron_betweenSessionAnalyticalPrecisi.description: Reproducibility of measurements across multiple analytical sessions over weeks to months. Not addressed in Table 3 of Horstwood et al. (2016), which reports only within-session validation results.

schema:name.const: Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical Precision and Assessment Method

geochron_detectionLimitDefault.title: Detection Limit
geochron_detectionLimitDefault.description: Session detection limit for U, Th, and/or Pb, demonstrating the reliability of reported concentrations near the detection limit. Not requested by Table 3 of Horstwood et al. (2016), which focuses on age uncertainty rather than elemental detection limits.

geochron_detectionLimitMethodDefault.title: Detection Limit Method
geochron_detectionLimitMethodDefault.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the session detection limit reported above.

geochron_limitOfQuantificationMethodDefa.title: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method
geochron_limitOfQuantificationMethodDefa.description: Reference or description of the method used to calculate the limit of quantification: the lowest concentration reliably measurable with acceptable precision and accuracy.

labxct_sampleDimensionsDefault.title: Sample Dimensions (L × W × H)
labxct_sampleDimensionsDefault.description: Physical dimensions of the sample in mm, reported as length × width × height (or equivalent three orthogonal measurements). The maximum dimension constrains the minimum achievable field of view and therefore the coarsest achievable voxel size. The minimum dimension determines how many voxels span the smallest feature of interest.

labxct_sampleMountingMethodDefault.title: Sample Mounting Method
labxct_sampleMountingMethodDefault.description: Method used to mount or hold the sample on the instrument rotation stage. Mounting material should transmit X-rays at the selected voltage without dominating beam attenuation. Report the holder type, adhesive or support material, and any alignment aids used.

labxct_samplePersistentIdentifierDefault.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
labxct_samplePersistentIdentifierDefault.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

labxct_samplePreparationNotesDefault.title: Sample Preparation Notes
labxct_samplePreparationNotesDefault.description: Any preparation steps applied to the sample before scanning, including cleaning, trimming, consolidation, or drying. XCT is typically non-destructive with no surface preparation required; note any exceptions.

labxct_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDef.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
labxct_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDef.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

labxct_xRayPowerDefault.title: X-ray Power
labxct_xRayPowerDefault.description: X-ray tube power in watts (W) registered by the procedure. Derivable as voltage (kV) × current (mA) = kV × µA / 1000. Power constrains the achievable focal spot size for microfocal tubes: higher power requires a larger focal spot, trading spatial resolution for SNR. Retained as a standalone field because it is routinely reported in the literature and directly constrains instrument operating limits. If power was varied across samples within the session, report the full range applied (e.g., 7–13 W).

labxct_sourceToObjectDistanceDefault.title: Source-to-Object Distance (SOD)
labxct_sourceToObjectDistanceDefault.description: Distance from the X-ray source focal spot to the centre of the sample rotation axis, in mm, as registered by the procedure. Together with SDD, determines geometric magnification (M = SDD/SOD). Shorter SOD increases magnification and reduces voxel size.

labxct_sourceToDetectorDistanceDefault.title: Source-to-Detector Distance (SDD)
labxct_sourceToDetectorDistanceDefault.description: Distance from the X-ray source focal spot to the detector surface, in mm, as registered by the procedure. Together with SOD, determines geometric magnification M = SDD/SOD. Voxel size ≈ detector pixel size / M (before binning; divide additionally by optical objective for Versa-class systems).

labxct_rotationStepSizeDefault.title: Rotation Step Size
labxct_rotationStepSizeDefault.description: Angular increment between successive projection images, in degrees. Equal to Rotation Range divided by Number of Projections when both are reported; however, some sources report step size as the primary rotation parameter without stating the total number of projections explicitly. Finer step sizes improve angular sampling and reduce streak artifacts at the cost of longer scan time.

labxct_framesAveragedPerProjectionDefaul.title: Frames Averaged per Projection
labxct_framesAveragedPerProjectionDefaul.description: Number of individual detector frames acquired and averaged to produce each saved projection image, as registered by the procedure. Frame averaging reduces random electronic noise. The effective exposure per projection = exposure time per frame × frames averaged.

labxct_detectorBinningDefault.title: Detector Binning
labxct_detectorBinningDefault.description: Detector pixel binning factor applied during acquisition. Binning combines adjacent pixels (e.g., 2×2 combines 4 pixels into one), reducing effective resolution while increasing per-pixel SNR and reducing file size. 1×1 indicates no binning.

labxct_reconstructionConvolutionFilterDe.title: Reconstruction Convolution Filter
labxct_reconstructionConvolutionFilterDe.description: Convolution (apodization) filter kernel applied during back-projection reconstruction. Sharper filters (Ram-Lak) enhance edge definition but amplify high-frequency noise; smoother filters (Hann, Hamming) reduce noise at the cost of edge sharpness. The choice represents a deliberate procedure-level tradeoff.

labxct_beamHardeningCorrectionParameterD.title: Beam Hardening Correction Parameter
labxct_beamHardeningCorrectionParameterD.description: Numerical value or setting applied in the software beam hardening correction algorithm for this specific analysis. May be tuned empirically per material type or per scan session. Analysis-level companion to Beam Hardening Correction Method.

labxct_ringArtifactCorrectionMethodDefau.title: Ring Artifact Correction Method
labxct_ringArtifactCorrectionMethodDefau.description: Procedure specification for how ring artifacts are handled. Ring artifacts appear as concentric circular bands centred on the rotation axis and arise from defective or miscalibrated detector pixels. Method is the procedure-level specification; whether correction was applied and its outcome are recorded at analysis level in Group 6.

labxct_ctNumberCalibrationDefault.title: CT Number Calibration
labxct_ctNumberCalibrationDefault.description: Whether the raw CT grayscale values have been calibrated to physically meaningful units using reference materials. Calibrated CT numbers enable cross-instrument and cross-session comparison and support phase identification by comparison to calculated linear attenuation coefficient (LAC) values (e.g., using MuCalc; Hanna & Ketcham 2017). Uncalibrated grayscale values are instrument- and session-specific.

labxct_segmentationThresholdValuesOrCrit.title: Segmentation Threshold Values or Criteria
labxct_segmentationThresholdValuesOrCrit.description: Specific CT number range(s) or quantitative criteria used to define each segmented phase or feature. Documenting these values enables reproducibility assessment and cross-study comparison. For LAC-calibrated datasets, report values in cm⁻¹.

labxct_phaseIdentificationMethodDefault.title: Phase Identification Method
labxct_phaseIdentificationMethodDefault.description: Method used to assign reconstructed CT number ranges to specific mineral phases or material types. Approaches include comparison to calculated linear attenuation coefficients (LAC), cross-validation with independent analytical techniques, or empirical calibration.

labxct_voiSelectionCriteriaDefault.title: VOI Selection Criteria
labxct_voiSelectionCriteriaDefault.description: Procedure-level rules specifying how the Volume of Interest (VOI) is to be defined for quantitative analysis. Common criteria exclude cone-beam artifact zones at sample edges, beam hardening halos near dense inclusions, and sample holder signal. The actual VOI applied in a specific analysis is recorded separately at analysis level.

labxct_outputBitDepthDefault.title: Output Bit Depth
labxct_outputBitDepthDefault.description: Bit depth of the reconstructed 3D volume (number of bits used to encode each voxel's grayscale value). Common values are 8-bit (256 gray levels), 16-bit (65,536 gray levels), or 32-bit floating point. Bit depth affects the dynamic range available for phase segmentation and quantitative attenuation analysis. The procedure may specify a required output bit depth if downstream analysis workflows depend on a consistent grayscale range; the analyst confirms or adjusts at analysis time.

labxct_partialVolumeEffectCriteriaDefaul.title: Partial Volume Effect Criteria
labxct_partialVolumeEffectCriteriaDefaul.description: Procedure-level specification of how partial volume effects (PVE) are managed in quantitative analysis. PVE produces intermediate CT numbers at phase boundaries and at the surfaces of small features, because each voxel integrates the attenuation of all material within its volume. PVE correction can be implemented via PSF-based deconvolution tools such as Blob3D. Record the minimum feature size criterion adopted for the procedure (in voxels or µm), the basis for it, the treatment of boundary voxels in modal abundance or size distribution calculations, and whether PVE correction is required or optional. Per Withers et al. (2021) a feature must span at least 3 voxels to be positively identified and at least 10 for reliable shape and volume characterisation; state whether the criterion follows that convention or is SNR-limited, PVE-limited or analyst-defined. The criterion materially changes reported modal abundances and size distributions, so two datasets are not comparable without it.

labxct_crossValidationProcedureRequireme.title: Cross-Validation Procedure Requirement
labxct_crossValidationProcedureRequireme.description: Procedure-level specification of what independent analytical validation is required to confirm CT segmentation results, phase identification, or quantitative measurements. Cross-validation is relevant where CT grey-values alone cannot uniquely distinguish phases with similar attenuation coefficients. Common approaches include BSE imaging, SEM-EDS or EPMA modal analysis, He pycnometry for bulk porosity, and Raman or SIMS phase mapping. Record the required validation method(s) and the sampling fraction (e.g., every sample, one per session, or a representative subset).

laicpms_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatioDefaul.title: Fusion Flux and Dilution Ratio
laicpms_fusionFluxAndDilutionRatioDefaul.description: For protocols using fused glass, the flux type and sample:flux dilution ratio used to prepare the analytical glass.

laicpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatmentDefau.title: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
laicpms_preAblationSurfaceTreatmentDefau.description: Protocol applied immediately before each analysis to remove surface contamination or condition the sample surface. Distinct from general sample preparation. For spot analysis, pre-ablation pulses are discarded before signal acquisition begins. For mapping, this step is typically omitted as the large area ablated averages out surface effects.

laicpms_instrumentIdentifierDefault.title: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier
laicpms_instrumentIdentifierDefault.description: Serial number or laboratory-internal identifier for the specific instrument unit. Supports traceability to instrument service records.

schema:name.const: Instrument Serial Number or Lab Identifier

laicpms_torchDepthDefault.title: Torch Depth
laicpms_torchDepthDefault.description: Distance between the load coil and the sampling cone tip (mm), also called injector depth or torch position depending on the instrument manufacturer. Affects ion transmission efficiency, oxide formation, and doubly-charged species production. The protocol specifies a target value optimised during initial setup; the analyst confirms or fine-adjusts during session tuning.

laicpms_laserEnergyDefault.title: Laser Energy
laicpms_laserEnergyDefault.description: Laser pulse energy in millijoules as set at the laser output or measured at the sample surface. Less commonly reported than fluence because it does not account for spot area. Report only when the system displays energy directly. Laser fluence (J cm⁻²) is the preferred quantity and is captured in Default Laser Fluence.

laicpms_transectOrMappingRateOrStepSizeD.title: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
laicpms_transectOrMappingRateOrStepSizeD.description: For continuous line scan (transect) and raster mapping: the stage translation speed in µm s⁻¹. This is the protocol-level parameter that, together with spot size and repetition rate, determines spatial resolution along the scan direction. For mapping, the mapping rate (mm² h⁻¹) may be reported as an alternative when scan speed is session-variable. For stepped line profiles: the distance between successive spot positions in µm.

schema:name.const: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size

laicpms_plasmaMakeUpGasAdditionDefault.title: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
laicpms_plasmaMakeUpGasAdditionDefault.description: Additional gas(es) mixed into the carrier stream downstream of the ablation cell, with the protocol-registered target flow rate. Ar make-up gas is standard. Small N₂ additions can enhance sensitivity for some elements. If N₂ is not added, state "None" explicitly to distinguish from not reported.

laicpms_signalSmoothingDefault.title: Signal Smoothing
laicpms_signalSmoothingDefault.description: Description of any signal smoothing device or approach installed between the ablation cell and the ICP-MS to reduce pulse-to-pulse signal variability. Note: active signal smoothing devices (e.g., squid, SCFAST) are generally incompatible with high-resolution raster mapping because they degrade spatial resolution by mixing aerosol from successive laser shots. For mapping analyses, report "None" explicitly.

laicpms_icPlasmaTuningDefault.title: ICP Tuning
laicpms_icPlasmaTuningDefault.description: Description of the approach used to optimise ICP plasma conditions prior to analysis, including the reference material used for tuning and the acceptance criteria (e.g., oxide production threshold, sensitivity targets, mass calibration).

laicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitorDefau.title: Doubly-Charged Species Monitor
laicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesMonitorDefau.description: The mass ratio monitored to estimate doubly-charged ion (M²⁺) formation during instrument tuning. Doubly-charged ions appear at half the mass of the parent ion and can cause isobaric interferences on analytes in that mass region. The monitor species and the mass positions monitored should be stated explicitly. Analogous to Oxide Production Method and Threshold for oxide monitoring.

laicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProductionDe.title: Doubly-Charged Species Production
laicpms_doublyChargedSpeciesProductionDe.description: Measured percentage of doubly-charged ion production for the monitored species at the time of instrument tuning. The protocol should specify the acceptable threshold (e.g., <1%, <3%); the measured value for each session is recorded here. Report both the threshold and the measured value where possible.

laicpms_reactionGasFlowRateDefault.title: Reaction Gas Flow Rate
laicpms_reactionGasFlowRateDefault.description: Flow rate of the reactive gas introduced into the dynamic reaction cell (DRC), in mL/min.

laicpms_outlierFilteringDefault.title: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
laicpms_outlierFilteringDefault.description: Method used to identify and remove anomalous signal spikes arising from micronuggets, inclusions, cracks, or instrument artifacts during time-resolved signal processing. Editable because the specific implementation may vary between sessions while remaining within the protocol framework.

laicpms_nonlinearResponseCorrectionDefau.title: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
laicpms_nonlinearResponseCorrectionDefau.description: Whether a correction was applied for nonlinear response at the transition between pulse-counting and analog detector modes.

laicpms_memoryEffectMitigationDefault.title: Memory Effect Mitigation
laicpms_memoryEffectMitigationDefault.description: Protocol applied to identify and minimise memory effects from high-concentration elements in the previous sample or standard that may contaminate subsequent analyses, or from incomplete aerosol washout between adjacent pixels in raster mapping mode. For mapping, the mitigation strategy involves controlling scan speed relative to washout time to ensure each pixel signal is sufficiently free of the preceding pixel's contribution.

laicpms_postAcquisitionNormalizationDefa.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
laicpms_postAcquisitionNormalizationDefa.description: Any post-acquisition normalization applied to correct for systematic biases identified from secondary reference materials, or stoichiometric normalization applied per pixel in mapping. Distinct from the primary internal standard approach captured in Internal Standard Approach.

sem_samplePersistentIdentifierDefault.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
sem_samplePersistentIdentifierDefault.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

sem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDefaul.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
sem_preAnalysisImagingAndScreeningDefaul.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

sem_beamRasterDimensionsDefault.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
sem_beamRasterDimensionsDefault.description: Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered during a single analysis point, reported as width × height in µm. Applicable when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement and distributes dose over a larger area to reduce beam damage on sensitive phases.

sem_beamDamageMinimizationDefault.title: Beam Damage Minimization
sem_beamDamageMinimizationDefault.description: Describes any measures taken to reduce electron beam damage to the sample during analysis. Examples: reduced accelerating voltage, lowered beam current, defocused or rastered beam, cooled stage, short acquisition sequences, or rotating between multiple points. Particularly important for volatile-bearing phases, hydrous minerals, glasses, organic materials, and biological samples.

sem_driftCorrectionDefault.title: Drift Correction
sem_driftCorrectionDefault.description: Describes whether and how stage or beam drift was monitored and corrected during the measurement session. Examples: periodic stage realignment to a fiducial marker, automated beam drift correction in acquisition software, or reanalysis of a reference point at regular intervals. Particularly relevant for long mapping runs and high-magnification sessions where positional accuracy affects data quality.

sem_chamberPressureDefault.title: Chamber Pressure
sem_chamberPressureDefault.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

sem_imagePixelSizeDefault.title: Image Pixel Size
sem_imagePixelSizeDefault.description: Physical size of each image pixel at the sample surface, in nm or µm. Defines spatial sampling of SE or BSE images. For large-area mosaic imaging, report the pixel size of individual tiles and the number and arrangement of tiles.

sem_backgroundPositionDefault.title: Background Position(s)
sem_backgroundPositionDefault.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

sem_ebsdFrameTimeDefault.title: EBSD Frame Time
sem_ebsdFrameTimeDefault.description: Acquisition time per EBSD diffraction pattern frame in milliseconds. Longer frame time improves pattern quality and indexing rate but increases total acquisition time.

sem_timeDependentIntensityCorrectionDefa.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
sem_timeDependentIntensityCorrectionDefa.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilisation or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates). Most commonly applied in WDS point analysis; uncommon for EDS or X-ray mapping.

sem_halogenCorrectionOnOxygenDefault.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
sem_halogenCorrectionOnOxygenDefault.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.

sem_blankCorrectionDefault.title: Blank Correction
sem_blankCorrectionDefault.description: Method and reference material(s) used to determine and subtract blank signal contributions (e.g., carbon coat contribution to C signal, or background contamination for trace elements).

sem_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrectio.title: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
sem_normalizationStandardsBasedCorrectio.description: Post-acquisition normalization applied using secondary reference materials to correct for session-to-session calibration drift.

sem_ebsdPatternQualityThresholdDefault.title: EBSD Pattern Quality Threshold
sem_ebsdPatternQualityThresholdDefault.description: Minimum pattern quality or confidence index threshold applied during EBSD data processing to exclude unreliably indexed points from orientation maps. Include metric name and threshold value.

sem_detectionLimitDefault.title: Detection Limit
sem_detectionLimitDefault.description: Method detection limit at 99% confidence, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set). Include the method used and the resulting value for each.

sem_analyticalPrecisionDefault.title: Analytical Precision
sem_analyticalPrecisionDefault.description: Reproducibility of repeated measurements on the same or equivalent reference material, expressed as 1-sigma relative standard deviation (%). Include reference material name, number of analyses (n), and value per analyte or element group.

sem_analyticalAccuracyDefault.title: Analytical Accuracy
sem_analyticalAccuracyDefault.description: Offset between measured and accepted reference values for secondary standards, expressed as percent relative bias. Include reference material, reference value source, and per-analyte value.

sem_countingStatisticsErrorDefault.title: Counting Statistics Error
sem_countingStatisticsErrorDefault.description: 1-sigma uncertainty propagated from counting statistics on peak and background intensities, for each reported concentration variable per analysis.

sem_clWavelengthCalibrationReferenceDefa.title: CL Wavelength Calibration Reference
sem_clWavelengthCalibrationReferenceDefa.description: Reference light source or standard material used to calibrate the wavelength axis of the CL spectrometer. Required for quantitative spectral CL and hyperspectral mapping.

semComposition_samplePersistentIdentifie.title: Sample Persistent Identifier
semComposition_samplePersistentIdentifie.description: Globally unique, persistent identifier for each sample listed in Sample Name. IGSN (International Geo Sample Number) is the recommended standard for geological and cosmochemical samples, as used by Astromat, EarthChem and SESAR. Where a sample and its sub-samples are separately registered, record the identifier at the level actually analysed.

semComposition_preAnalysisImagingAndScre.title: Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening
semComposition_preAnalysisImagingAndScre.description: Imaging or other characterisation performed before the measurement in order to select or locate the analysed target, including the technique, instrument and settings used, and how individual analyses are linked back to the images. Distinct from any imaging the procedure performs as its own measurement. Where the imaging is performed on a separate instrument, it should also be recorded in the Group 1 coupling fields.

semComposition_beamRasterDimensionsDefau.title: Beam Raster Dimensions
semComposition_beamRasterDimensionsDefau.description: Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered during a single analysis point, reported as width × height in µm. Applicable when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement and distributes dose over a larger area to reduce beam damage on sensitive phases.

semComposition_beamDamageMinimizationDef.title: Beam Damage Minimization
semComposition_beamDamageMinimizationDef.description: Describes any measures taken to reduce electron beam damage to the sample during analysis. Examples: reduced accelerating voltage, lowered beam current, defocused or rastered beam, cooled stage, short acquisition sequences, or rotating between multiple points. Particularly important for volatile-bearing phases, hydrous minerals, glasses, organic materials, and biological samples.

semComposition_driftCorrectionDefault.title: Drift Correction
semComposition_driftCorrectionDefault.description: Describes whether and how stage or beam drift was monitored and corrected during the measurement session. Examples: periodic stage realignment to a fiducial marker, automated beam drift correction in acquisition software, or reanalysis of a reference point at regular intervals. Particularly relevant for long mapping runs and high-magnification sessions where positional accuracy affects data quality.

semComposition_chamberPressureDefault.title: Chamber Pressure
semComposition_chamberPressureDefault.description: Chamber pressure and gas type during analysis. Required for variable pressure (VP-SEM) and environmental SEM (ESEM) modes. Report value and unit (Pa or Torr) and gas composition. Use 'None' for standard high-vacuum operation.

semComposition_backgroundPositionDefault.title: Background Position(s)
semComposition_backgroundPositionDefault.description: Location(s) of off-peak background measurement(s) relative to the peak, in mm or sin-theta, and whether on the high- or low-energy side.

semComposition_timeDependentIntensityCor.title: Time-Dependent Intensity Correction
semComposition_timeDependentIntensityCor.description: Type of time-dependent intensity (TDI) correction applied to compensate for beam-induced volatilisation or migration of sensitive elements (e.g., Na, K, F in glasses, feldspars, carbonates). Most commonly applied in WDS point analysis; uncommon for EDS or X-ray mapping.

semComposition_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.title: Halogen Correction on Oxygen
semComposition_halogenCorrectionOnOxygen.description: Whether oxygen content was adjusted to account for halogen substitution (F and/or Cl replacing OH) in halogen-bearing phases such as apatite, amphibole, and mica, where oxygen is calculated by stoichiometry.
